sv.title: Gruvbolag pressas på ljusröd Stockholmsbörs
sv.summary: Stockholmsbörsen inleder onsdagen med små rörelser efter tisdagskvällens starka Nvidiarapport. Flera gruvbolag pressas i den inledande handeln.

en.title: Mining companies pressured on bright red Stockholm Stock Exchange
en.summary: The Stockholm Stock Exchange opens Wednesday with small movements after Tuesday evening's strong Nvidia report. Several mining companies are under pressure in early trading.
